title: Restore the IRS Forms assisted setup registration removed by the CLEAN25 sweep
summary: The IRS Forms setup wizard registration that was accidentally removed during a code cleanup sweep has been restored, allowing US users to access the 1099 setup guide from the Assisted Setup list again.
key_points: Re-registers the IRS Forms Guide wizard in Assisted Setup from codeunit 10030 with an unconditional OnRegisterAssistedSetup subscriber
Setup is marked complete when an IRS Reporting Period record already exists
The IRS Reporting Period read is guarded by ReadPermission so the Assisted Setup page still opens for users without access
Adds test codeunit 148025 IRS Forms Assisted Setup Tests (6 tests) covering registration, completion logic and title, description and help link
